findings.summary: Pre-promotion review evidence mixed the later delivery-debt disposition into local promotion.
findings.failure_scenario: A local accepted-risk declaration bypasses the stricter post-promotion delivery-debt phase.
findings.impact: A P2 could be waived before current-head PR evidence exists.
findings.minimum_fix: Require resolved local findings and retain standalone-P2 debt handling in commit-push.

findings.summary: Initial candidate attribution did not prove a real prior Git base.
findings.failure_scenario: A fabricated or self-referential base is copied into state and work proof.
findings.impact: Candidate provenance could be self-consistent without being ancestral.
findings.minimum_fix: Require the work-proof base to resolve and be a strict ProductCandidate ancestor.

findings.summary: Repair-budget policy and history could be rewritten inside the ProductCandidate.
findings.failure_scenario: A later repair edits or removes PROCESS-016 state before its final commit.
findings.impact: The one-repair lifecycle budget could be reset.
findings.minimum_fix: Require exact task-state equality at the strict prior work-proof base.

residual_risks: The repo-local installed Factory bootstrap remains unavailable on this historical branch base.

state_impact: Only M0-14 canonical acceptance is rebound after review.
source_of_truth_changes: Promotion phase separation, strict base provenance, and repair-budget inheritance now fail closed.
feedback_plan: Protected CI validates the final DeliveryHead.
blast_radius: Promotion evidence only; no product packages.
rollback_or_deletion_test: Focused regressions fail if any of the three current-head closures is removed.
systems_questions.system_model_summary: The terminal batch closes three exact promotion-policy gaps without adding an authority framework.
